places-synevyr-strymba-maramarosh-2.story: From Kolochava it runs 264 km to Kolochava; allow about 4 h 33 of riding. The stops in between: Gorgany, Yasynia-Tserkva of Our Lord’s Ascension, Maramarosh and back through Yasynia-Tserkva of Our Lord’s Ascension. The highest point is about 1,150 m. The line favours views over speed.
